purpose: Teach: ちがう/浮い/曲げ/騒い/脱い/滑り/冷やし/返せ

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、そのレシピ、本気で、絶対、ちがう、絶対、わよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, that recipe is completely wrong.
lines.style: Gentle concern wrapped in certainty. Warm tone—not criticizing, just stating a fact she knows well. Slight lean forward, like sharing something obvious she wants Aoi to understand.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お味噌汁に、本気で、絶対、浮い、絶対、てる、絶対、お豆腐、絶対、お洒落でしょ?メイちゃん
lines.en: Mei, you think tofu floating in miso soup is stylish?
lines.style: Playful, almost teasing. Quick, bright energy. A laugh lives in her voice—she's testing Mei gently, inviting her to see the absurdity too. Light and alive.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お皿、本気で、絶対、曲げ、絶対、たデザイン、絶対、お洒落ね、メイちゃん
lines.en: But that curved plate design really is beautiful, Mei.
lines.style: Sincere shift. Slower pace now. She means it. Quiet appreciation in the voice—noticing the good thing Mei pointed out. A small warmth underneath.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、隣のお店、本気で、絶対、騒い、絶対、で困るよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: The noise from the shop next door is really getting in the way though, Mei.
lines.style: Resigned but matter-of-fact. A sigh lives in this—she's stated a problem she can't solve. Dry humor in the delivery, like she and Mei are both stuck with it.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、お靴、本気で、絶対、脱い、絶対、で、絶対、お上がりいただくの、メイちゃん
lines.en: We're asking customers to remove their shoes before coming in, you know.
lines.style: Explaining something she's decided on. Thoughtful pace. There's care underneath—protecting the space she and Mei have built. Quiet conviction, not defensive.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お店の床、本気で、絶対、滑り、絶対、止め、絶対、貼ったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: I actually put down anti-slip tape on the floor, Mei.
lines.style: Brightens slightly. A note of small pride here—she solved something. Still energetic but grounded. Matter-of-fact practicality with a hint of 'look what I figured out.'

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、冷やし、絶対、コーヒー、絶対、新メニュー、絶対、人気ね、メイちゃん、本気for
lines.en: The iced coffee really has become our most popular new item, hasn't it?
lines.style: Genuine delight. Warm recognition of something working. Pace is easy, conversational. She's sharing good news with someone who cares. Soft smile in the voice.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お貸出ししたカップ、本気で、絶対、返せ、絶対、ないお客様、絶対、いるのよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Some customers just don't return the cups we lend them, though.
lines.style: Weary, knowing humor. A small laugh of frustration underneath. She's stating an annoying reality she's gotten used to. Dry but not bitter—just the reality of running a shop.
